parsed.notes:
Dein Skillset is a requirements section; no section heading marks skills optional. The framework and GenAI examples therefore count as required.
The highest degree named is the optional Ph.D.; the preceding unspecified degree is required, but the schema permits only one degree label.
Software solution conception and design are provisionally mapped to software-architecture; enterprise architecture is retained separately as unmapped because it is not necessarily software architecture.
On-premises implementation is explicitly requested but has no matching taxonomy entry.
The inline idealerweise qualifies the AI/GenAI context, not the ability to design and develop software; AI and GenAI are independently required elsewhere.
Degree fields and industry experience are excluded as fields of study and domain knowledge. Technologies appearing only under Deine Mission are excluded.
Schlagworte is treated literally as search metadata, not a candidate-requirements or dedicated tech-stack section.
